value.rationale: An exact all-size null-variance classification for monochromatic edge statistics under fixed class histograms is a natural statistical identifiability question. Rank phase changes from full generic edge module to balanced/star-only and one-singleton/regular-only restrictions, with a closed graph-degree-dependent variance formula; this explains when prescribed-composition permutation nulls give identically constant counts. The structural distinctions are more substantive than an isolated routine moment.
